grammar-de-part-dev-negative-initial.explanation: The prompt explicitly requires ordinary sentence-initial capitalization to be lowercased in normalizedMembers; the model copied the capital despite correctly resolving every grammatical field.

grammar-de-part-dev-abbreviation-n.explanation: The prompt explicitly says negative particles retain Polarity=Neg and the context labels this as an abbreviation of nicht; the model preserved abbreviation identity but dropped the already-taught polarity feature.

grammar-de-part-dev-focus-selbst.explanation: The prompt and demonstrations explicitly require lowercasing ordinary sentence-initial capitalization; the model nevertheless copied the initial capital into normalizedMembers.
